'''Emic Sandor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He and [[Darth Charnus|his master]] looked on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for the secret [[Order of Revan|Revanite cult]] in order to destroy them.
